== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Empire's New Order (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_28</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 29), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-29-Empires_New_Order.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-empiresneworder-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Empire's New Order (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent’s alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, your admirals, generals, moffs, and Emperor are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_28</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-29-Empires_New_Order-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B06 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
